method.name: milp_transportation
steps: Decision variables: x[w][p] = number of containers shipped from warehouse w to port p (integer, >=0)
Constraints: (1) Supply limit: sum_p x[w][p] <= supply[w] for all w; (2) Demand satisfaction: sum_w x[w][p] = demand[p] for all p

method.name: network_flow_transport
steps: Model as min-cost transshipment network: source -> warehouse nodes (capacity=supply) -> port nodes (demand) -> sink
Arc costs: 30 * distance[w][p] per container; arc capacities: unlimited
Single commodity flow: send exactly demand[p] units to each port p; don't exceed supply at any warehouse
Integer flows to respect container discreteness; objective = total transport cost

method.name: milp_balanced_transport
steps: Introduce dummy port to absorb excess supply (total supply 124 > total demand 114, excess=10)
Full square matrix: 6 warehouses x 6 destinations (5 real ports + 1 dummy); dummy demand = 10
Cost to dummy port = 0 (unused containers stay put)
Decision: x[w][p] integer >=0; supply constraints sum_p x[w][p]=supply[w]; demand constraints sum_w x[w][p]=demand[p]
